receivers.title: Whatever an agent sends, in any order, the wallet only ever pays allowlisted receivers
receivers.statement:
def Wallet.Claim.AllowedReceiversOnly :
  Prop :=
  forall (p : Wallet.Policy) (s : Wallet.State) (reqs : List Wallet.Req) (r : Wallet.Req),
  Membership.mem (Wallet.acceptedReqs reqs (Prod.snd (Wallet.run p s reqs))) r → Membership.mem
    (Wallet.Policy.allowed p) (Prod.fst (Prod.snd r))

slidingday.title: Within any stretch shorter than a day, the wallet pays out at most one day's cap
slidingday.statement:
def Wallet.Claim.SlidingDayCap :
  Prop :=
  forall (p : Wallet.Policy) (s : Wallet.State) (reqs : List Wallet.Req) (t0 : UInt64),
  LE.le (Wallet.State.spentToday s) (Wallet.Policy.perDayCap p) → (forall (r : Wallet.Req),
    Membership.mem reqs r → And (LE.le t0 (Prod.fst r))
      (LT.lt (HSub.hSub (Prod.fst r) t0) (Wallet.Policy.dayLength p))) →
  LE.le (Wallet.allowedSum reqs (Prod.snd (Wallet.run p s reqs))) (UInt64.toNat (Wallet.Policy.perDayCap p))

slidingtwice.title: Within any stretch shorter than a day, the wallet pays out at most twice the daily cap
slidingtwice.statement:
def Wallet.Claim.SlidingTwiceCap :
  Prop :=
  forall (p : Wallet.Policy) (s : Wallet.State) (reqs : List Wallet.Req) (t0 : UInt64),
  LE.le (Wallet.State.spentToday s) (Wallet.Policy.perDayCap p) → (forall (r : Wallet.Req),
    Membership.mem reqs r → And (LE.le t0 (Prod.fst r))
      (LT.lt (HSub.hSub (Prod.fst r) t0) (Wallet.Policy.dayLength p))) →
  LE.le (Wallet.allowedSum reqs (Prod.snd (Wallet.run p s reqs)))
    (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (UInt64.toNat (Wallet.Policy.perDayCap p)))

nonce.title: The nonce counts the payments the wallet made, exactly
nonce.statement:
def Wallet.Claim.NonceCountsPayments :
  Prop :=
  forall (p : Wallet.Policy) (s : Wallet.State) (reqs : List Wallet.Req),
  Eq (UInt64.toNat (Wallet.State.nonce (Prod.fst (Wallet.run p s reqs))))
    (HAdd.hAdd (UInt64.toNat (Wallet.State.nonce s))
      (List.length (Wallet.acceptedReqs reqs (Prod.snd (Wallet.run p s reqs)))))

pertx.title: Every payment the wallet ever makes is within the per-payment cap
pertx.statement:
def Wallet.Claim.PerTxCapAlways :
  Prop :=
  forall (p : Wallet.Policy) (s : Wallet.State) (reqs : List Wallet.Req) (r : Wallet.Req),
  Membership.mem (Wallet.acceptedReqs reqs (Prod.snd (Wallet.run p s reqs))) r → LE.le (Prod.snd (Prod.snd r))
    (Wallet.Policy.perTxCap p)
